title: Exports: Terraform writer and reader, Export from tenant (with the ZIA policy framework part), policy and configuration workbooks

checks.what: Tenant names with ${}, %{}, heredoc, #, //, /* */, \u / \U escapes, quotes, backslashes and bidi controls stay one inert string in every .tf file (strict HCL parser)
No raw C0/C1 control, line separator or bidi mark in a Terraform string or comment
Pack values never spliced into an HCL expression (Cloud App Control default action)
Unknown SSL action keys from a pack stay in a one-line comment
Writer -> pack library reader keeps names, descriptions, patterns, phrases, expressions, engines, order and containment settings
Writer -> reader keeps labels, notification template and pinned tenants
write_workspace never writes through a planted symlink; files 0600; the team's files, state, tfvars and links stay
Every rule exported in tenant order by name (rule_order and rules.tf), 10,000 rules, odd orders tolerated
10,000 rules: build + zip under 64 MB peak; Terraform under a second, no quadratic forecast or label scan
Tenant text in policy, location and Client Connector workbooks never starts a cell as a formula; no <f> element (no CSV output in these files)
Every ...Pass / password / token / key field of SDK 1.11.3's ZCC models is left out; logins counted
The framework part leaves out users, groups and locations and says so, alone and with DLP parts
Framework capture names the rules cut at 200 per area
Download and zip member names are [a-z0-9_-] one folder deep, never a Windows device name; workbook names [A-Za-z0-9_-]
A location list cut at the page cap is reported incomplete; a short page ends the read
A non-numeric location id never reaches the request path
Exports only GET / list; no write call (fakes refuse writes)

findings.title: Client Connector passwords named ...Pass (exitPass, uninstallPass, ziaDisablePass ...) reached the Client Connector workbook
findings.fix: is_secret treats 'pass' (and 'passphrase') as a secret word, per SDK 1.11.3 zcc/models/manage_pass.py; bypass settings stay

findings.title: An uploaded pack's Cloud App Control default action (actions_by_verb '*') was spliced unquoted into the HCL actions expression
findings.fix: the default is written with hcl_str, so it stays one string literal

findings.title: write_workspace wrote through a symlink planted in the workspace folder (overwrote a file outside it)
findings.fix: a link is removed first and every file is opened with O_NOFOLLOW (owner-only as before)

findings.title: Terraform strings and comments carried raw control characters (ESC, NUL, C1, U+2028/2029) and the U+061C bidi mark from tenant names
findings.fix: hcl_str and hcl_template_str write them as \uNNNN; hcl_comment replaces them with U+FFFD

findings.title: A 10,000-rule Terraform export took about a minute: load_pack ran the quadratic rate-limit forecast it never uses, and Slugger scanned every label
findings.fix: load_pack reads pack.json directly (_pack_meta); Slugger keeps labels in a set; 10k rules now take under a second

findings.title: A rule order, sub-rule order or proximity that is not a whole number ended Export from tenant with a ValueError
findings.fix: _whole() parses tenant numbers; an odd order sorts last, an odd proximity is dropped

findings.title: With DLP parts, the framework part's left-out list (users, groups, locations) was missing from pack.json and the job result
findings.fix: the framework's not_exported entries join meta.not_exported tagged part=framework; the count follows

findings.title: zia_rate._simulate is O(n^2) (a list scan per request): every pack load of a 10k-rule pack (library, deploy, upload) spends tens of seconds on the forecast
findings.fix: bisect on the sorted request times; outputs are identical (checked against the old code on randomised inputs)
findings.proposed_patch:
diff --git a/zia_rate.py b/zia_rate.py
index ebe6b82..ed69f67 100644
--- a/zia_rate.py
+++ b/zia_rate.py
@@ -881,17 +881,20 @@ def _day_clock(t: float) -> str:
 def _simulate(rules: List[Tuple[int, float]], prior: List[float], start: float, n: int) -> List[float]:
     """When each of `n` requests goes out, starting at `start`, after the
     `prior` ones, at the (count, window) `rules`."""
+    import bisect
     sim = sorted(prior)
     out: List[float] = []
     t = start
     for _ in range(n):
         wait_s = 0.0
         for lim, w in rules:
-            inside = [x for x in sim if t - x < w]
-            if len(inside) >= lim:
-                wait_s = max(wait_s, inside[-lim] + w - t)
+            # sim is kept sorted: the requests inside the window are a
+            # suffix, found by bisection, not a scan (a 10k-rule pack).
+            inside = len(sim) - bisect.bisect_right(sim, t - w)
+            if inside >= lim:
+                wait_s = max(wait_s, sim[len(sim) - lim] + w - t)
         t += max(0.0, wait_s)
-        sim.append(t)
+        bisect.insort(sim, t)
         out.append(t)
     return out

findings.title: ops_zia_baseline.capture cuts an area at 200 rules (MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES) without saying which rules were left out
findings.fix: name each rule beyond the cap in not_exported with the reason
findings.proposed_patch:
diff --git a/ops_zia_baseline.py b/ops_zia_baseline.py
index 0b63607..e42aaac 100644
--- a/ops_zia_baseline.py
+++ b/ops_zia_baseline.py
@@ -1819,6 +1819,11 @@ def capture(client, areas: Sequence[str], *, name: str = "", tenant_label: str =
             c = _capture_rule(area, r, len(out) + 1, fw["not_exported"])
             if c:
                 out.append(c)
+        if len(out) > MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES:
+            # A framework holds at most MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES rules per area (load_framework refuses more): say which were cut.
+            for c in out[MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES:]:
+                fw["not_exported"].append({"name": c["name"], "area": AREAS[area]["label"],
+                                           "reason": f"beyond the {MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES} rules a framework holds per area; recreate it in the target tenant"})
         if out:
             fw["areas"][area] = out[:MAX_FRAMEWORK_RULES]
         _log(f"Reading the tenant: {AREAS[area]['label']}: {len(out)} rule(s) captured.")

findings.title: A location list longer than the page cap (50 x 1000) was exported as if complete
findings.fix: _read_list returns the cut as a reason; the workbook Summary and result errors say the list is incomplete (groups too)

findings.title: The sub-location read put the tenant-supplied location id into the request path unchecked ('1/../../adminUsers')
findings.fix: only a numeric id is sent; another is named in errors and not read

findings.title: A pack named CON, NUL, AUX, COM1 or LPT1 downloaded as con.zip with a con/ folder (cannot be saved or unzipped on Windows)
findings.fix: folder_name() adds _pack to a Windows device name; zip_pack, zip_export and terraform_files use it

findings.title: An Infinity rule order (policy exports) or child count (locations) raised OverflowError
findings.fix: OverflowError is caught with TypeError / ValueError

findings.title: tools/quality_score.py refuses the wave-6 findings template: root keys 'files' and 'coverage' and the finding key 'proposed_patch' are unknown, so this record (and the score check) fail validation
findings.fix: accept the template's optional keys in ROOT_KEYS and FINDING_KEYS (checked: this record then validates)
